description: Wrap a Codex CLI stdio MCP server (from ~/.codex/config.toml) so it can be restarted reliably. Rewrites the MCP entry to launch mcpgo's Node wrapper that respawns the original command. Restart Codex CLI to take effect.

mcp_name.description: The mcp_servers.<name> entry in ~/.codex/config.toml to wrap

name: wrap_codex_mcp_stdio
